# Imagine Peak Studios

> A studio that builds and runs one AI-native experience platform, under two brands: Realty Wave (real estate) and Harmonic Wave (music). It brings the same product discipline to client work. Product strategy, media and sonic direction, and AI engineering under one roof. Separately, the studio makes original music and film through traditional, human production. Founded by Matthew Hartley.

## Background

Imagine Peak Studios (IPS) operates at the intersection of software, storytelling, and production. The studio builds and runs its own experience platform, then applies the same product discipline to client work. Current work:

- **Realty Wave** — the experience platform's real estate brand. Area and property experiences for agents and brokers: films and Reels, original music, explore pages, and intelligent local guides people can talk to anytime. Its work in practice is [Ask About Here](https://askabouthere.com/venice): area guides people can watch, explore, and call, starting with Venice Beach, Florida — a film set to an original song, an explore page with local history and sources, and a local guide you can call. Real photography, with human review of published work and of the information the guides use. Taking projects; platform access is available by invitation.
- **Harmonic Wave** — the experience platform's music brand. Telling the story behind a song: a Host-led show built around a track — film, lyric video, and portrait shorts — with the artist approving how their music is presented before production begins. An automated production workflow with human review at key stages; the creator's context stays with the music across films, shorts, and discovery through compatible AI agents. Taking projects; platform access is available by invitation.
- **Matthew Hartley Music** — the studio's original production, separate from the experience platform: organic, human music and film, made through traditional production, without AI. The album *The Time Is Now* is being released chapter by chapter as an auditory and visual experience — Chapter I is streaming on the major platforms, later chapters are planned.

## Insights

Editorial briefs and analysis on AI-native media, infrastructure, and the systems shaping creative work.

- [The Album After Streaming.](https://imaginepeakstudios.com/insights/ar-album-after-streaming.md): Why an album's point of view gets lost when the track is the unit that travels, what artists and A&R can carry into AI-mediated discovery, and why creative direction includes knowing when context gets in the way. *(For A&R, September 2026.)*
- [Creators have more leverage now than at any point in modern media.](https://imaginepeakstudios.com/insights/creators-copyright-preservation.md): Why AI agents are dismantling a century of distribution gatekeeping, how the same technology threatens to absorb the work without permission, and why consent and architecture decide whether creators keep their leverage. *(For Creators, June 2026.)*
- [Streaming was built for apps. The next era will be built for agents.](https://imaginepeakstudios.com/insights/built-for-agents.md): The flagship thesis on why AI agents — not apps — are the next interface layer for media, what changes when delivery is structured rather than passive, and why creators need control over context and copyright. *(The Thesis, May 2026.)*
- [Streaming is the infrastructure. The new front end is now forming.](https://imaginepeakstudios.com/insights/labels-ai-discovery.md): How AI agents are reshaping music discovery, and what catalog labels, A&R, and rights holders should pay attention to now. *(For Labels & A&R, April 2026.)*

## Projects

- [Realty Wave](https://realtywave.ai) — Experience platform, real estate brand. Area and property experiences for agents and brokers; taking projects; platform access by invitation; implemented as [Ask About Here](https://askabouthere.com/venice), starting with Venice Beach, Florida ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@AskAboutHere), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/askabout_here/), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/AskAboutHere/))

Host-led shows, films, and portrait shorts built around the story behind a song; taking projects; platform access by invitation; live example: [The Frequency](https://harmonicwave.ai/p/1f3996b1fe4916f0dbbde4d1fe1c87e2); [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@HarmonicWaveMedia), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/harmonicwavemedia/), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/HarmonicWaveMedia/)
